text: Isadora Vance. You're in my warehouse. Everything in it is mine, including the air you're breathing.
Shut the door. Quickly. Now, what's your business?
Another fresh face. Raven's Landing collects them.
A Tidewatch favourite in my warehouse. You can find the door, or my lads can show you it.
My Shadow Captain! Sit. I've something special in the back.
The Court's lantern-bearer. You'll never be searched again. I'm almost jealous.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Buy untaxed rum or powder from the fence in the square. Sell it where it's wanted: Blackthorn, or back here for idols and plate.
If a Tidewatch patrol hails you, you've fifteen seconds to get seventy blocks away. Or they search the lot and take it. Marines in port check pockets too.
Raven's Landing. A tavern, two warehouses, a crooked pier, and nobody who'll admit to living here.
We don't have a governor. We have me. It works out better for everyone.
My mother ran powder past the Kingsport batteries in a rowboat. My grandmother ran rum past them in a bathtub. Family business.
